column1: # Where the AutoCAD R13 install-disc drawings of docs/data/r13-autodesk-discs.tsv come from. LOCAL EVIDENCE ONLY (Griffin, 2026-10-26): the licence is unclear, so
# these files are never pinned in tools/corpus/pins.tsv, never fetched by CI and never committed. This table records where to get them so the evidence can be reproduced.
# Five disc images, third-party uploads on archive.org (item page https://archive.org/details/<archive_org_item>):
#   auto-cad_202406 / AutoCAD-R13.ISO       AutoCAD Release 13, the base disc
#   acadr13de / R13c4a_update.iso           Release 13 C4a update, German (the item is named acadr13de)
# archive.org serves a file inside a disc image at https://archive.org/download/<archive_org_item>/<iso_file>/<path_in_iso with / written %2F>; that is the url column.
# The disc images themselves were never downloaded whole: only the AC1012 drawings below were fetched, one request each, on 2026-10-26, each checked against its sha256.
# The sha256 of an ISO is therefore not recorded; archive.org lists each file's md5 and sha1 at https://archive.org/metadata/<archive_org_item> (not read for this table).
# Whether an item can still be downloaded was last observed on 2026-10-26 (all 263 rows below were fetched that day) and has not been re-tested since.
# 263 rows = the 263 AC1012 drawings of the five images, 68 of them distinct by sha256 (docs/data/r13-autodesk-discs.tsv has the distinct ones).
